chapter.verse: Jesu ahihleh Olive Mual ah pai hi.
Zingsang tuungin biakinnpi ah pai leuleu a, tusukin mite thuhilh hi.
Laisiamte leh Pharisee-te in angkawm laitaka kiman numei khat paipih uh a, amaute' laizang ah a koih khit uh ciangin
Jesu' kiangah, “Sya aw, hih numeinu angkawmin a om laitak a kituakkha ahi hi.
Tu-in Thukhun sungah Moses in hih bang numeite suang tawh denlup dingin eite thupiak hong nei hi. Tua ahih manin nang'n na bangci ngaihsut hiam?” ci uh hi.
Hih pen Jesu a mawhsak theih nadingun zia-et kam a pau uh ahi hi. Jesu kunsukin a khutme tawh leilak ah laigelh hi.
A dot teitei uh ciangin Jesu dingto-in amaute' kiangah, “Note' lakah mawhneilo pen in numeinu suang tawh deng masa ta hen,” ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Jesu kunsuk leuleu-in leilak ah laigelh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin khanghamte pan kipanin khatkhit khat paikhia uh a, Jesu leh ama' mai-a a ding numeinu bek omlai uh hi.
Jesu dingto-in numeinu' kiangah, “Numei aw, amaute koi ah om uh hiam? Kuamah in mawhsak thu hong khen lo hiam?” ci hi.
Numeinu in, “Topa aw, kuamah in mawhsak thu hong khen lo hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Ke'n zong kong khen kei ding hi. Pai inla, tu-a kipan mawhna bawl nawn kei in,” ci hi.)
Khatvei leuleu, Jesu in mite' kiangah thu gen a, “Kei pen leitung khuavak ka hi hi. Kei hong zui peuhmah khuamial sungah lampai lo ding a, nuntakna khuavak nei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin Pharisee-te in ama' kiangah, “Nangma' thu nangmahmah in teci na pang hi; na teci panna a maan hilo hi,” ci uh hi.

Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Keima' thu keimahmah in teci ka pang phial zongin ka teci panna a maan mah ahi hi. A hang pen kei koi pan hong pai-in koi ah va pai ding cih ka kithei hi. Ahih hangin note in kei koi pan hong pai-in koi ah va pai ding cih nong thei kei uh hi.
Note in cilesa tungtawnin thu na khen uh a, kei ka hihleh kuama' tungah thu ka khen kei hi.
Thu ka khen leh zong ka thukhenna a maan ahi hi. A hang pen kei guak' khen hilo-in kei hong sawlpa Zuapa tawh a khenkhawm ka hih man hi.
Na Thukhun sung uhah mi nih teci panna maan hi, ci-in kigelh hi.
Kei pen keima' thu teci a pangpa ka hi a, kei hong sawlpa Pa in keima' thu teci pang hi.”
Tua hangin amaute in, “Na Pa koi ah om ahi hiam?” ci uh hi. Jesu in, “Kei ka hi-a ka Pa ahi zongin nong thei kei uh hi. Kei hong thei hileh uhcin ka Pa zong na thei ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Hih thute Jesu in biakinnpi ah a thuhilh laitak, sumpi kuang gei-a a gen ahi hi. Ahih hangin ama' hunlenai tung nailo ahih manin kuamah in amah man lo hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Kei ka paikhia ding a, kei nong zong ding uh hi. Tua ciangin na mawhna sung uhah na si ding uh hi. Ka pai nading mun nong pai theikei ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin Jew mite in, “‘Ka pai nading mun nong pai thei kei ding uh hi,’ ci ahih manin amahmah kithah sawm ahi ding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Note pen nuailam pan na hi uh a, kei pen tunglam pan ka hi hi. Note pen leitung pan na hi uh a, kei ka hihleh leitung pan ka hikei hi.
Na mawhna sung uhah na si ding uh hi, kong ci khin hi. A hang pen kei amah ka hihlam na up kei uhleh na mawhna sung uhah na si ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin amaute in, “Nang kua na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin Jesu in, “A kipatcil pan kong gengensa bang lian ka hi hi.
Note' vai, gen ding thu tampi leh thukhen ding tampi ka nei hi. Ahih hangin kei hong sawlpa a thumaan hi a, ama' kiangpan ka zak thute leitung ah ka tangko hi,” ci hi.
Amau' tungah Pa' thu a gengen ahihlam mite in tel lo uh hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Mihing' Tapa na khaitoh uh ciangin kei amah ka hihlam leh kei' thu-a ka sep bangmah om lo-in ka Pa' hong hilh dan lianin a paukhia ka hihlam na thei ding uh hi.
Tua banah kei hong sawlpa zong kei tawh omkhawm hi. Ama' lungkim thute bek sem den ka hih manin amah'n zong kei kia hong nusia lo hi,” ci hi.
Hih thute a gen ciangin mi tampi in Jesu um uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amah a um Jew mite' kiangah, “Ka thu sungah na omkip uhleh ka nungzuite na hi taktak uh hi.
Thumaan thutak zong na thei ding uh a, tua thumaan thutak in note hong suaktasak ding hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Ko pen Abraham' suanlekhakte ka hi uh a, cikmahin kuamah' kiangah sal ka tang ngei kei uh hi. Bangci bangin, ‘Note hong kisuaktasak ding,’ hong ci thei na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah mawhna a bawl mi peuhmah mawhna' sila ahi hi.
Sila pen inn sungah a tawntungin omkip lo a, tapa ahihleh a tawntungin omkip hi.
Tua hi a, tapa in hong suahtaksak leh na suakta takpi ding uh hi.
Note Abraham' suanlekhak na hih uh kong thei hi; himah taleh ka thu in note' sungah mun ngah lo ahih manin thah nong sawm uh hi.
Kei pen ka Pa' kianga ka muhte a genkhia ka hi a, note pen na pa uh' kiangpan na zakte uh a sem na hi uh hi.”
Tua mite in, “Ka pupi uh Abraham ahi hi,” ci uh hi. Jesu in, “Note Abraham' suanlekhak na hih uhleh Abraham' septe a sem ding na hi uh hi.
Tu-in ahihleh Pasian' kiangpan ka zaksa thumaan thutak a hong genpa keimah thah nong sawm uh hi. Abraham in tua bangin sem lo hi.
Note pen na pa uh' septe a sem na hi uh hi,” ci hi. Amaute in, “Kote nulepa tatkhialhna pana piang ka hikei uh hi. Pa khat ka nei uh a, Pasian mahmah ahi hi,” ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin gen hi: “Pasian pen note' Pa hi takpi leh kei nong it ding uh hi. A hang pen Pasian' kiangpan hong pai ka hi a, tu-in hih takah ka om hi. Kei' thu-a hong pai hilo-in amah in kei hong sawl hi.
Bang hangin ka thugen tel lo na hi uh hiam? A hang pen ka thugen na za theikei uh hi.

Note pen na pa uh dawimangpa' kiangpan na hi uh a, na lungsim uhah na pa uh' deihna bang sep ding na ut uh hi. Amah pen a patcil pan mithat khat hi a, ama' sungah thumaan thutak om lo ahih manin thumaan thutak tawh teeng lo hi. Zuau a phuah simsimin ama' thu-a a phuah ahi hi. A hang pen amah zuauphuak khat hi a, zuau thu citeng ii pa ahi hi.
Kei ka hihleh thumaan thutak gen ka hih manin nong um kei uh hi.
Note' lakah ka mawhna hong lak thei kua om na hi uh hiam? Thumaan thutak gen ka hihleh bang hangin hong um lo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian' kiangpan hong pai peuhmah in Pasian' thugente za uh hi. Tuate na zaklohna uh a hang pen Pasian' kiangpan na hihloh man uh ahi hi.”
Jew mite in amah dawng uh a, “Nang Samaria mi, dawilawm nei khat, ci-a kong gen uh maanlo ka hi uh hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Dawilawm nei ka hikei hi. Tua sangsikin ka Pa ka pahtawi a, note na hih uhleh kei nong daisak uh hi.
Himah taleh keima' aituam minpha ka zong kei hi; kei' ading hong zonsak Khat om a, amah in thu zong khen ding hi.
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah mi khatpeuh in ka thu a zuih leh a tawntungin sihna tuakkha ngeilo ding hi,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin Jew mite in, “Tu-in dawilawm nei na hihlam kong thei ta uh hi. Abraham si khin a, kamsangte zong si khin hinapi, ‘Mi khatpeuh in ka thu a zuih leh a tawntungin sihna ciamkha ngeilo ding hi,’ na ci hi.
Nang pen a si khin i pupi Abraham sangin lianzaw na hi hiam? Kamsangte zong si uh hi. Nang kua a kici nuam na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in dawng a, “Keimahmah minpha a kipiatawm ka hihleh ka minphatna a mawknapi hiding hi. Kei minpha hong pia pen, ‘Amah i Pasian ahi hi,’ na cih uh keima' Pa ahi hi.

Tua hi a, note in amah na theih nailoh uh hangin ke'n amah ka thei hi. Amah ka thei kei, a ci ding ka hihleh note mah bangin kei zong zuauphuak ka suak ding hi. Ahi zongin amah ka theitel a, ama' thu ka mang hi.
Na pupi uh Abraham zong keima' ni a muh ding lawp mahmah a, mu takpi-in nuam mahmah hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mite in, “Nang kum sawmnga zong pha nailo, Abraham mu ngei na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah Abraham a pian ma-in kei pen keimah ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin amaute in Jesu deng dingin suang tawm uh a, ahih hangin Jesu kiseeltawmin biakinnpi pan pusuak hi.
